lines.zh: 我沿着珊瑚走，触须一直在探。
lines.en: I walk the coral with antennae probing ahead.

lines.zh: 我十条腿一起动，速度快得看不清。
lines.en: Ten legs move at once, too fast to follow.

lines.zh: 我从礁石这面翻到那面。
lines.en: I clamber from one face of the reef to the other.

lines.zh: 水草太密，我从根缝里钻。
lines.en: The weeds are thick; I slip between their roots.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一弹，整个人往后跳。
lines.en: A flick of my tail throws me backward.

lines.zh: 我贴在海葵边上走，那里安全。
lines.en: I walk beside the anemone, where it is safe.

lines.zh: 沙子进不了我的壳，我照走。
lines.en: Sand cannot get in my shell; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁壁往上爬，爪子抓得牢。
lines.en: I climb the reef wall; my claws hold well.

lines.zh: 前面有只大鱼，我绕了半圈。
lines.en: A big fish is ahead, so I go half around it.

lines.zh: 我一跳一跳地过石缝，像弹豆子。
lines.en: I hop the stone gaps like a popping bean.

lines.zh: 深水那边更暗，我照旧走。
lines.en: The deep side is darker; I walk it anyway.

lines.zh: 我钻进草丛，草叶弹回来合上。
lines.en: I dive into the grass and the blades spring shut.

lines.zh: 我的触须碰到东西，就先停。
lines.en: When my antennae touch something, I stop first.

lines.zh: 我搬着腿，慢慢挪上那块珊瑚。
lines.en: I work my legs and climb onto that coral.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑，几乎不扬泥。
lines.en: I skim the sand and barely stir the silt.

lines.zh: 礁洞口太窄，我侧身挤进去。
lines.en: The reef hole is tight. I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把触须收短。
lines.en: I stop and draw my antennae in.

lines.zh: 一群鱼冲过来，我贴地躲开。
lines.en: A school rushes past. I drop low and let it go.

lines.zh: 我举着两只小螯，等人来清洁。
lines.en: I hold up two small claws, waiting for a customer.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖触须，水里有味道。
lines.en: I twitch my antennae; something is in the water.

lines.zh: 我给一条鱼清完鳃，它走了。
lines.en: I finished a fish's gills, and it left.

lines.zh: 我藏在珊瑚缝里，只露触须。
lines.en: I hide in a coral crack with only antennae out.

lines.zh: 我的壳刚换过，还软。
lines.en: I have just molted; my shell is still soft.

lines.zh: 我数着漂过来的碎屑，一片两片。
lines.en: I count the scraps drifting by, one and two.

lines.zh: 海葵的触手碰我，有点痒。
lines.en: The anemone's tentacles brush me and tickle.

lines.zh: 我清洁过最大的鱼，有我的二十倍。
lines.en: The biggest fish I cleaned was twenty times my size.

lines.zh: 我蹲在草叶上，慢慢嚼东西。
lines.en: I perch on a grass blade and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 有寄生虫爬过来，我伸螯夹住。
lines.en: A parasite crawls near; my claw nabs it.

lines.zh: 我抖抖水，壳上的沙掉了几粒。
lines.en: I shake and a few grains fall off my shell.

lines.zh: 这条礁我熟，每条缝都钻过。
lines.en: I know this reef; I have been in every crack.

lines.zh: 我听见大螯敲壳的声音，躲了躲。
lines.en: I hear a big claw knock shell and flinch.

lines.zh: 我趴着不动，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: I lie still and let the current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 你身上有寄生虫吗，我看看。
lines.en: Do you have parasites? Let me look.

lines.zh: 我只有一点血，你别踩。
lines.en: I have one heart; do not step on me.

lines.zh: 你的脚趾缝里，好像有东西在动。
lines.en: Something seems to move between your toes.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，触须一直抖。
lines.en: I look up at you, antennae quivering.

lines.zh: 你要清洁服务吗，很快的。
lines.en: Do you want a cleaning? It is quick.

lines.zh: 你的皮太干，我夹不动。
lines.en: Your skin is too dry; my claws cannot grip it.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种大个子，走得很响。
lines.en: I know your kind; you walk loudly.

lines.zh: 我在珊瑚上，你在上面，隔着水。
lines.en: I am on the coral, you above, with water between.

lines.zh: 你的影子落下，我缩了一半。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and I shrink by half.

lines.zh: 别用手抓我，我会弹走。
lines.en: Do not grab me; I will snap away.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，里面露出来。
lines.en: My shell is split and the inside shows.

lines.zh: 一点血的我，经不起这一下。
lines.en: With one heart, I cannot take that.

lines.zh: 我弹开时翻了个身，腿乱抓。
lines.en: Springing away, I flip and claw at nothing.

lines.zh: 我躲进海葵里，触手护着我。
lines.en: I hide in the anemone and its tentacles shield me.

lines.zh: 我的螯软了，夹不住东西。
lines.en: My claw has gone weak and cannot grip.

lines.zh: 血混进水里，很淡一点。
lines.en: A faint thread of blood mixes into the water.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴卷进腹部，缩得更小。
lines.en: I curl my tail under my belly and shrink smaller.

lines.zh: 触须断了一截，还在抽。
lines.en: Half an antenna is gone and still twitching.

lines.zh: 我疼得直抖，可还得走。
lines.en: I tremble with pain but still must move.

lines.zh: 这一下差一点就把我打没了。
lines.en: That blow nearly ended me outright.

lines.zh: 你指头上有点碎肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: There is a bit of flesh on your finger; I smell it.

lines.zh: 我举着螯，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I raise my claws and edge closer.

lines.zh: 这点东西比寄生虫好吃。
lines.en: This beats eating parasites.

lines.zh: 我试探着夹一下，又松开。
lines.en: I test it with a pinch, then let go.

lines.zh: 我不抢，等其他虾先上。
lines.en: I do not rush; let the other shrimp go first.

lines.zh: 你手别动，我一惊就弹开。
lines.en: Keep your hand still; one startle and I spring away.

lines.zh: 我清洁惯了，看见碎屑就想夹。
lines.en: Cleaning is habit; scraps make my claws itch.

lines.zh: 那味道顺着水过来，很淡。
lines.en: The smell comes through the water, very faint.

lines.zh: 我饿了一整天，礁上没什么可吃。
lines.en: I have fasted a day; the reef offers little.

lines.zh: 你放在珊瑚上，我就过去。
lines.en: Set it on the coral and I will come.

lines.zh: 你一脚踩塌了半块珊瑚。
lines.en: One step of yours caves in half the coral.

lines.zh: 我被震得翻了个身，腿乱蹬。
lines.en: The shock flips me over; my legs flail.

lines.zh: 我的壳被蹭出一道白痕。
lines.en: A white scuff shows on my shell.

lines.zh: 别在礁上跺脚，我在下面。
lines.en: Do not stomp the reef; I am underneath.

lines.zh: 水流把我推到你脚背上。
lines.en: The current pushes me onto your foot.

lines.zh: 我弹开的时候撞了石壁。
lines.en: Springing away, I hit the stone wall.

lines.zh: 你这下把我震出了草丛。
lines.en: That knocked me clean out of the grass.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你怎么看得见。
lines.en: I am this small; how did you even see me?

lines.zh: 触须断了一根，我心疼。
lines.en: One antenna broke, and I mourn it.

lines.zh: 退后一步，我还没躲好。
lines.en: One step back; I have not hidden yet.

lines.zh: 我们俩加起来才两点血。
lines.en: Together we have only two hearts.

lines.zh: 你跟着我，钻进这条礁缝。
lines.en: Follow me into this reef crack.

lines.zh: 我把螯举起来，你也举起来。
lines.en: I raise my claws; you raise yours.

lines.zh: 水草下面够暗，没人会看。
lines.en: Under the weeds it is dark; nobody will look.

lines.zh: 你替我清触须，我替你清壳。
lines.en: You clean my antennae; I clean your shell.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴着，腿碰着腿。
lines.en: We lie side by side, legs touching legs.

lines.zh: 这块珊瑚是我们的，别让别的虾来。
lines.en: This coral is ours; keep other shrimp off it.

lines.zh: 你跳一下，我也跳一下。
lines.en: You hop once, and I hop once.

lines.zh: 深水那边更安全，我们搬过去。
lines.en: The deep side is safer; let us move there.

lines.zh: 有你在，我清洁的活也轻了。
lines.en: With you here, my cleaning work feels lighter.

lines.zh: 我夹起一粒沙，丢到旁边。
lines.en: I pinch a grain of sand and toss it aside.

lines.zh: 这块碎珊瑚我举得起来。
lines.en: I can lift this piece of broken coral.

lines.zh: 太滑了，夹了三次都掉。
lines.en: Too slippery; it slips three times.

lines.zh: 我把寄生虫夹出来，扔进水里。
lines.en: I pull a parasite out and flick it away.

lines.zh: 你要这个？我还没吃完。
lines.en: You want this? I am not done eating.

lines.zh: 我抱着它走，腿都不够用。
lines.en: I carry it along and run out of legs.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进礁缝里存着。
lines.en: I stuff it into a reef crack for later.

lines.zh: 碎的壳我留着，能补自己的。
lines.en: I keep shell bits; they patch my own.

lines.zh: 我捡到的都归我，规矩如此。
lines.en: What I find is mine; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 它比我还大，我推着走。
lines.en: It is bigger than I am; I push it along.

lines.zh: 那条鱼的鳃上有白点，我看见了。
lines.en: That fish has white spots on its gills; I see them.

lines.zh: 有寄生虫的味道，很近了。
lines.en: The smell of parasites is close now.

lines.zh: 我锁定那条大鱼的侧腹。
lines.en: I lock onto that big fish's flank.

lines.zh: 有东西在礁缝里动，我盯着。
lines.en: Something moves in the crack; I stare at it.

lines.zh: 我先看它是不是来吃我的。
lines.en: First I check whether it means to eat me.

lines.zh: 那只海龟背上全是壳虫。
lines.en: That turtle's back is covered in shell bugs.

lines.zh: 我举螯，往它的鳞缝里探。
lines.en: I raise a claw and reach into its scale seam.

lines.zh: 目标不大，正好一口。
lines.en: The target is small, one bite exactly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等它游近。
lines.en: I hold still and wait for it to swim near.

lines.zh: 它一停，我就上去了。
lines.en: The moment it stops, I am on it.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，找能落脚的地方。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for a place to land.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就抓牢。
lines.en: When it moves, I hold tight.

lines.zh: 我从尾巴那头靠近，那里看不见我。
lines.en: I approach from the tail, where it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 它的鳃盖一开，我就钻进去。
lines.en: When its gill cover opens, I slip inside.

lines.zh: 我在等它安静下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for it to settle.

lines.zh: 这活要快，慢了会被甩掉。
lines.en: This work must be quick, or I get thrown.

lines.zh: 我把螯张到最大，准备夹。
lines.en: I open my claws wide and prepare to pinch.

lines.zh: 它身上有伤，那里最招虫。
lines.en: It has a wound, and wounds draw bugs.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁壁挪，避开水流。
lines.en: I creep along the reef wall, out of the current.

lines.zh: 再近一寸，我就够到了。
lines.en: One inch closer and I can reach.

lines.zh: 我夹它一下，它几乎没感觉。
lines.en: I pinch it once and it barely notices.

lines.zh: 我的螯太小，只能夹软的地方。
lines.en: My claws are small; I can only pinch soft spots.

lines.zh: 它甩尾，我被甩出两米。
lines.en: It flicks its tail and throws me two meters.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下，撞在它眼睛边。
lines.en: I spring and smack beside its eye.

lines.zh: 这一点血，我也敢夹。
lines.en: Even with one heart, I dare to pinch.

lines.zh: 我夹住不放，它开始乱动。
lines.en: I clamp on and it starts thrashing.

lines.zh: 我的螯咔了一声，没断。
lines.en: My claw clicks once, but does not break.

lines.zh: 它回头看我，我立刻松手。
lines.en: It looks back at me, and I let go at once.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁里，我替大鱼清寄生虫。
lines.en: In the reef I clean the big fish.

lines.zh: 我钻进礁缝，它进不来。
lines.en: I dive into the crack; it cannot follow.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚缝里出来，壳还是软的。
lines.en: I come out of a coral crack, shell still soft.

lines.zh: 这一窝三只，我最小。
lines.en: Three of us in this brood; I am the smallest.

lines.zh: 水是暖的，礁上到处是缝。
lines.en: The water is warm and the reef is full of cracks.

lines.zh: 我一出来就开始找活干。
lines.en: I start looking for work the moment I emerge.

lines.zh: 深水珊瑚礁那边更暗，我知道路。
lines.en: The deep reef is darker; I know the way.

lines.zh: 红色草甸的水草很软，适合藏。
lines.en: The red meadow's weeds are soft and good for hiding.

lines.zh: 我抖抖腿，站直了。
lines.en: I shake my legs and stand straight.

lines.zh: 身边那只比我早出生一会儿。
lines.en: The one beside me was born a moment earlier.

lines.zh: 海草床的味道，我记住了。
lines.en: I memorize the smell of the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 我先找海葵，那里最安全。
lines.en: First I find an anemone; that is safest.

lines.zh: 水变热了，我的壳发红。
lines.en: The water heats and my shell turns red.

lines.zh: 我从礁上摔下去，壳磕了一下。
lines.en: I fall from the reef and crack my shell.

lines.zh: 我离开水，腿只能乱蹬。
lines.en: Out of water, my legs can only flail.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀进珊瑚缝里。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a coral crack.

lines.zh: 箭尖削掉我一小片甲壳。
lines.en: The arrowhead shaves off a sliver of my shell.

lines.zh: 一股麻意钻进我的小壳。
lines.en: A numb force seeps into my small shell.

lines.zh: 没碎屑可吃，我只能啃草。
lines.en: With no scraps, I can only gnaw weed.

lines.zh: 白光下来，我整只都僵了。
lines.en: White light falls and I go rigid.

lines.zh: 我的钳子够不到任何东西。
lines.en: My little claws reach nothing.
